text:
sam: Kicking off a controlled ramp for feature_flag:new-routing-v3. Deploys to runtime are done, canary -> 1% for 10m. tagging release notes. short plan: pin model, canary, step up cohorts.

.deploy-bot: [deploy] canary created 2391234567 target=service-routing-v3 cohort=canary-1pct

elaine: Observability: I pushed a p95 baseline. If p95 > 200ms (+20%) we rollback. watching dashboards :eyes:

maria: Ops: We'll pin model version rv2.4 for this rollout. Sam pls confirm before FF increase.

sam: confirmed. pinning now.

sam: /deploy pin routing-v3@rv2.4

deploy-bot: action: pinned routing-v3 -> rv2.4 (uid: pb-7782)

harry: seeing a small bump in 401 retries from edge (auth). Not sure if related to new routing.

sre_oncall: throttling suggestion: pause ramp, move to 0.5% and triage. @sam

sam: pausing ramp. @deploy-bot set-ff new-routing-v3 0.5%

deploy-bot: feature flag update: new-routing-v3 -> traffic 0.5% (paused)

elaine: traces suggest token expiry at edge proxy — retry storm. Not model. Quick fix: token refresh tweak landing in PR #3456.

maria: set a 30m stability gate after patch before we increase traffic. Prefer conservative checks.

product_ops: adding note to release notes: "Potential edge token-exchange regression fixed in patch; brief hold during ramp." ETA ~35m.

sam: decision: wait for PR #3456 patch, then resume to 5% for 30m, then 25%, then 100% over ~3h. Rollback condition: p95 regression >15% from baseline.

deploy-bot: PR #3456 merged, CI green. Ready to deploy patch. /deploy patch edge-token-refresh

harry: patch applied to canary edge nodes. monitoring.

deploy-bot: patch rollout completed to canary edge group.

elaine: p95 back to baseline, retries dropped. Recommend resume ramp.

sam: resuming: new-routing-v3 -> 5% (30m hold)

deploy-bot: feature flag update: new-routing-v3 -> traffic 5%.

sre_oncall: keeping watch on latency panels and token-refresh logs. I'll ping on anomalies.

sam: thanks team. I'll post again when we hit 25%.
